idea-plugin.name: Remote Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Remote Runner exposes your open IntelliJ projects' run configurations through the IDE's built-in web server. List configurations as JSON, filter by project name or path, and start a configuration remotely. The plugin uses the server port configured in the IDE (63342 by default Tools | Web Browsers and Preview | Built-in Server | Port); it does not open a separate port.

API endpoints

  • GET /api/run/configurations: list configurations. Add ?project=<project-name-or-path> to filter.
  • POST /api/run/configurations/run?name=<configuration-name>: start a configuration. Add &project=<project-name-or-path> to select a project when needed. Returns 202 Accepted when the configuration is queued to run.

Examples

List configurations:

curl "http://localhost:63342/api/run/configurations"

List configurations for a project:

curl --get --data-urlencode "project=my-project" "http://localhost:63342/api/run/configurations"

Start a run configuration:

curl --get --request POST --data-urlencode "name=My Run Configuration" "http://localhost:63342/api/run/configurations/run"

Start one in a specific project:

curl --get --request POST --data-urlencode "name=My Run Configuration" --data-urlencode "project=my-project" "http://localhost:63342/api/run/configurations/run"

Replace port 63342 if the built-in web server is configured to use another port.
